title: Euclase

inlines.v: EU'CLASE, noun [Gr. to break; easily broken.] A mineral, a species of emerald, prismatic emerald, of a greenish white, apple or mountain green, bluish green, or dark sky blue color. It is a rare mineral, and remarkably brittle, whence its name.
